2609.00714.title: ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything
2609.00714.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.
2609.00714.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的多代理系統（MAS）顯示出解決複雜任務的強大潛力，但它們的發展迫使我們進行權衡：代碼框架表達能力強但工程密集，而無代碼構建工具簡化了創作，但將代理互動限制在作者定義的工作流程中。我們介紹 ChatDev 2.0：DevAll（以下簡稱 DevAll），這是一個無代碼平台，用於構建、執行和檢查異構 MAS，提供高表達性和易用性。在表達性方面，DevAll 將可執行的聲明式圖抽象與循環感知執行引擎相結合，使得異構代理和動態及循環互動能夠在單一框架內表示和執行。為了易用性，集成的視覺界面使用戶能夠完全不寫代碼就能創建、運行、監控和檢查 MAS，包括人機交互步驟。實驗表明，DevAll 在三個具有代表性的任務中重現了最先進的 MAS，並且在性能上具有競爭力，且無需特定任務的協調代碼，突顯了其作為基於 LLM 的 MAS 的通用平台的有效性。DevAll 可在 https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev 獲得。
